description.text: A 34-card special set, released on 25 March 2015, the first of the XY series, of the Pokémon and people of Team Magma and Team Aqua, whose owner's Pokémon came back with it; Team Aqua's Kyogre-EX and Team Magma's Groudon-EX lead it. It came in blister packs, each with four seven-card packs and a pin and coin of one team.
